'''Grokan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A member of a group of genius techno-criminal Niktos known as [[the Circle]], he was imprisoned along with them on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Grokan participated in the [[Project Noble Focus]], in which the Republic used a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] machine to get a reading out of him. Grokan and the Circle got free during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]], when Sith Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] approached them, seeking the information on the [[Mother Machine]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grokan appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Belsavis.
